description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the distribution of participant counts across different evaluation criteria for a claim retrieval system. The vertical axis displays the evaluation criteria, labeled “Criterion,” with categories listed in alphabetical order from bottom to top: “Veracity Explanation,” “Filters,” “Overall Summary,” “Clarity and Simplicity,” “Relevance Explanation,” “FC Summary,” and “Relevant FCs.” The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of Participants,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at intervals of 2. Each criterion is represented by a single bar with a gradient of color from green to dark blue. The “Veracity Explanation” and “Filters” criteria each have a bar length corresponding to a value of 1, while “Overall Summary” and “Clarity and Simplicity” each have a bar length of 2. “Relevance Explanation” has a bar length of 3, and “FC Summary” has a bar length of 5. The “Relevant FCs” criterion has the longest bar, with a length corresponding to a value of 6. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
